turns.reply: The URL highlighter now accepts tildes, and the span covers the whole URL. I'll submit.

I added `~` to the character class of the URL pattern in `rich/highlighter.py`, so `ReprHighlighter` now highlights URLs containing tildes as a single `repr.url` span. I checked this with one inline run, not the test suite, and submitted a 1-file patch.
